content.title: CCT: Cross-consistency training for Clone Detection and Code Search Tasks
content.TL;DR: We present a novel approach for pre-training the language models for better code and text representation improving results in code search and clone detection.
content.abstract: Clone detection is a well known task, which could be formulated on any programming language. Although to the best of our knowledge there is no cross-lingual clone detection task formulated. In this work we formulate such a task alongside with a specific training procedure CCT for a deep leaning language model. This procedure allows CCT-trained model to outperform the existing approaches on POJ-104 benchmark with result of 95.67\% MAP and on newly created cross-lingual clone detection benchmark XCD. Moreover, CCT model shows new state of the art results in code search task AdvTest 47.15\% MRR.
